hold_text: APPROVAL GIVEN 2026-09-24 — and this stays `hold` ON PURPOSE. The Tier-2 OK this was held for was given by the operator in chat, in answer to a direct question that named what merging does: 'merging IS the VM mutation ... the only thing that converts the ada_pullback_2h promotion from merged into OBSERVED'. They chose 'Approve - merge, restart, verify' over both 'merge only, no restart' and 'hold'. So the approval covers the DEPLOY, not just the land. [!] WHY THIS IS NOT FLIPPED TO `self`. R15 requires a record under docs/claude/work/approvals/ that already exists at the merge-base, and that directory is LANDING MACHINERY: writing an approval is itself a held, human-read PR, specifically so a session cannot self-land PR A that grants its own PR B. That asymmetry is the control, not an obstacle, and the manager did not manufacture a credential to get past it. [!] SO THE ROUTE IS THE ONE CLAUDE.md ACTUALLY PRESCRIBES FOR TIER 2: 'Prepare + validate, get one operator OK in chat, then ship and verify the post-state.' The hold keeps AUTO-merge off, which is correct — nothing here should land unattended. The manager merges deliberately, then owes the restart and the reading. [!] NOT DONE ON THE MERGE: merge -> ~5 min for ict-git-sync -> restart ict-trader-live via the system-actions allowlist -> scripts/ops/verify_running_roster.py must report reload_state `current` for accounts_yaml ON THE VM. That last reading is what closes E31, E32, R2 and B2.
why: Adds GET /api/bot/runtime-config to ict-web-api.service (Tier-2: a route the live service serves) and one additive key to the runtime_status.json inter-process contract, written by ict-trader-live. It also adds a load-time stamp inside src/units/accounts/load_accounts, which Coordinator.multi_account_execute reaches on the order path -- the stamp is a module-global assignment wrapped so a failure to OBSERVE degrades to 'no stamp' and dispatch continues byte-for-byte, and no order path reads it back. No strategy logic, no risk cap, no sizing, no gate: config/accounts.yaml and config/strategies.yaml are untouched. Held for the operator OK the tier requires, then the manager lands AND deploys -- this row does not reach `done` until the trader has restarted and verify_running_roster.py reports `current`.
